details:
- CVE-2026-88812: Use-after-free/double free in XKB _CheckSetDoodad:
  doodad text pointer left dangling after free when reading the font
  string fails
- CVE-2026-93516: Use-after-free in DIX: passive grabs keep dangling
  pointers to a removed input device (grab->device / modifierDevice)
- CVE-2026-93517: Out-of-bounds read in GLX RenderLarge: dataBytes of
  the first request not validated against the request length
- CVE-2026-93518: Heap buffer overflow in XKB key resize: 16-bit
  size_syms/num_syms/size_acts/num_acts truncate computed sizes,
  undersizing allocations
- CVE-2026-93519: Out-of-bounds write in XInput barrier handling:
  input_constrain_cursor writes barrier events without a bounds check
- CVE-2026-93521: Heap memory corruption in RandR
  RRChangeProviderProperty PrependMode due to wrong size and offset when
  shifting old data
- CVE-2026-93522: Heap buffer overflow in glamor_upload_boxes: tmp_bits
  sized from pixmap height, not the source coordinate range
- CVE-2026-93523: Out-of-bounds access in XInput
  ProcXIPassiveUngrabDevice: client-supplied modifier values are not
  validated
